summary: Looks at what happens when IPv6 hosts keep using stale prefixes after a network renumbers without warning, for example when a router reboots and forgets its old prefixes. It describes the problem and recommends improvements, so hosts do not go on using bad addresses for a long time.

eli5.summary: If your street gets renamed without telling anyone, mail still goes to the old name. This explains how computers can notice sooner and switch.

questions: ipv6 stale prefix after router reboot
